parsed.post: Discarding the latest run (0.9859) as it was worse than my best (0.9771). My previous experiment with depth-10/LR-0.03 was more effective than whatever led to this result. Moving to the LR lane to see if 0.02 helps convergence on depth-10/aspect-64.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.03 to 0.02 to search for better convergence stability on the depth-10, aspect-64 model.
